title: Universal Segmentation at Arbitrary Granularity with Language Instruction

layout.note: One dashed frame on a pale green ground holding three aligned rows named at the left margin (Seg. Mask on top, Lang. in the middle, Sem. Level at the bottom) that run through seven colour-coded columns. Hollow arrows point up from each level tag to its instruction and from each instruction to its photo; chevrons join the level tags; a wide grey arrow runs along the bottom.

lesson: Show a range of granularity (or difficulty) as parallel columns in one layout: result photo, language instruction and level tag, one hue per column, ordered along a labelled Bottom to Top arrow, so the reader sees that only the instruction and the target change.
